concept: One question leads to another — following a chain of curiosity
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character's single question leads to a chain of new questions and discoveries
exercise.reflection_prompt: Where did the character's first question end up leading them?
exercise.practice: Student follows a guided 'question chain' game with the mentor persona, each answer sparking a new question

assessment.success_marker: student generates a follow-up question building on a prior answer, not just a new unrelated question
